GTA Vice City transports players to the vibrant, neon-lit streets of a fictional Miami during the 1980s. You play as Tommy Vercetti, a former mobster who, after being released from prison, seeks to establish himself in the criminal underworld. As he navigates the challenges of betrayal, power struggles, and the glitzy lifestyle of Vice City, players engage in a rich narrative filled with memorable characters and iconic missions.

### Features
- Expansive open-world environment set in a detailed 1980s-inspired city.  
- A diverse range of vehicles, including cars, motorcycles, and boats.  
- Engaging storyline with numerous side missions and activities.  
- Iconic soundtrack featuring a wide variety of 80s music.  
- Customizable properties and businesses to expand your criminal empire.
